text: - It all started with me being curious and thinking to myself, how many birds are there in Palworld? | - So I went on Wiki and found some, then went on Reddit to discuss with people, how many more birds are there and what actually classified as a bird or not. | - "No that's a Wyrm not a bird", "No thats a Platypus!, No thats a Duck!, No its neither you fools!!" | - So yeah :D, I was already having more fun with this idea than I would have imagined, the chaos, the cuteness, the community aspect of everyone finding birbs, it all made sense!!
- As the birb army started to grow across various games, it was clear to me that just one screenshot folder is not going to cut it | - So I began to organise them into their own separate folders

- I played Ori and the Will of the Wisps which was absolutely gorgeous, and that turned these "Screenshots" to "Photographs" | - I began working on the website, nothing fancy just running locally on my laptop just so I could have a better viewing experience

- I finally gave my project a name "The Aviary Log" as it actually started to feel like an actual project! | - Began to work on making it look and feel usable with list for selecting between different games | - Though now I was facing another issue, I was using a csv file as my database for the photos, and I was writing every entry MANUALLY!! which on top of collecting pictures and interacting with people on Reddit was taking a huge amount of time | - I was spending more time keeping up with the csv file than actually taking photos, it felt like I was a farmer coming back to my farm daily to tend to my crops!

- I made a small python program to automate this, before it became a bigger issue, now all I had to do was drop my photos in a folder, and Voila! it would fill the csv for me automatically | - It was honestly the best, saved me so much time!!! | - Now I could actually focus on the photo collecting part and working on more features for my project :D

- For my main section I was just using a picture I grabbed from google images, I wanted to make something of my own | - So I went on Canva to make a Collage out of the different photos I had captured so far | - It was honestly super fun :D I spent like 3-4 hours making it and honestly I really like the end result | - It also has a theme, the ones on the top are the birds who got into the hands of evil, while on the bottom are the ones who received kindness, the middle is from Bloons TD 6, which I really like and it all ties the Collage together

- My Legion 5 laptop black screened and EVERYTHING was gone, I went to the service center, and according to them my motherboard got messed up | - I had to go back to my old i5 default intel GPU Thinkbook, I couldnt even play most of the games that I now did play | - "The Aviary Log" project was officially dead

- I made so much progress with my project that I was not about to give it up that easily, I began to work on remaking everything | - This time, even better designed, more optimised, more features, this setback ignited something else within me!! | - With a new start, we need a new name too, dont we? So as you now know why this project is titled "The Avian Atlas" :D | - Also added a section for games having no birds, absolutely pathetic! | - Made the photos per game sortable :)

- Added the music player to my website, I thought it would be fun addition to listen to music while exploring, cause I certainly do! haha :D | - To add onto the fun aspect of it, I made the entire website go full vibe rave mode, Is it excessive? Maybe? Am I gonna change it? Absolutely Not!!

- Added a whole secret section to my website! Who doesn't love Easter Eggs?! | - An About Me section which I obviously didnt fill with too many hobbies!!, and this LogBook for keeping track of changes being made to this project :) | - Uploaded the project onto Github, this time no black screen will wipe my project!

- Actually filled the Dev Log up! Phew!! Also added a Thank you section for the sweet comments regarding this project :D | - I think I am done with the development for a while, time to record some birbs!!!!
